name: Golf Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Grab your golf club, aim carefully, adjust your power and take the shot! Golf Mania is a casual multiplayer golf game that is all about precision, timing and quick thinking. Compete in real-time against up to 12 players on fun maps. Be the first to sink your ball into the hole, or find the smartest path through challenging golf courses full of obstacles and clever shortcuts. Invite and play with your friends or family in online matches. Choose your character skins and customize your golf ball to stand out from the crowd. Level up and unlock upgrades like shot distance and ball trajectory to improve your chances of winning.
